questions.question: What is the full form of PROM?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Programmable read-only memory**__

__
 
• PROM stands for **Programmable Read-Only Memory.**
 
• Read-only memory (ROM) is a type of memory that is used in electronics and computers.
 
• It is a non-volatile memory, that is, information stored in such memory is permanent and cannot be changed.
 
• **The other two types of ROM are**
 
 
• **Electrically Erasable Programmable ROM (EEPROM)**
 
• **Erasable Programmable ROM (EPROM)**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Primary memory can be divided into RAM (Random Access Memory) and ROM (Read Only Memory)

• **E.V. Ramaswami Naicker **started the Self R**espect Movement.**
 
• He is also known as Periyar.
 
• The objective of the movement was to end **Bramhanical domination in society.**
 
• He felt that it was the prime instrument of exploitation of the lower caste.
 
• One of the methods he employed was to** ****organise marriage without Brahmins.**

• He was the first recipient of India's highest civilian award, the **"Bharat Ratna". **
 
 
 
• ​**C. N. Annadurai **was the first Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: Who described the preamble of Indian Constitution as the 'Political horoscope of the Indian Constitution'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanhaiyalal Maniklal Munshi**__.

__
 
• Kanhaiyalal Maniklal Munshi described the preamble of the Indian Constitution as the **'Political horoscope of the Indian Constitution'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Preamble of the Indian constitution is based on "Objectives Resolution".
 
• It was drafted and moved by Pandit Jawahar Lal Nehru and adopted by the constituent assembly.
 
• In the historic case of Kesavananda Bharati (1973), Supreme Court held that Preamble is a part of the constitution and can be amended under article 368, subject to the condition that no amendment is done to the "Basic structure".
 
• The Preamble has been amended only once so far, in 1976 by the 42nd Constitutional amendment Act.
 
• The term ‘Socialist’, ‘Secular’, and ‘Integrity’ were added to the preamble through 42nd Amendment Act, 1976. 
 
• ‘Socialist’ and ‘Secular’ were added between ‘Sovereign’ and ‘Democratic’.
 
• ‘Unity of the Nation’ was changed to ‘Unity and Integrity of the Nation’.
 
• By the 42nd Constitutional amendment act 1976, three new words - Socialist, Secular and Integrity are added to the preamble.

questions.question: Which law states that the volume of an ideal gas at constant pressure is directly proportional to its absolute temperature?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Charles's law.**__

__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• In 1787, Jacques Charles formulated** Charles' Law or the Law of Volume.**
 
• According to this law, at constant pressure, the volume of a given mass of gas is directly proportional to its temperature.
 
• This is mathematically represented as** V/T = Constant, at constant pressure. **

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0dadeb1c8ec4654752b6aff1fffaebede4ce14eabb92c1487e17ea58bf3032e.png] 

 

 
• If the pressure remains constant, the volume of the given mass of a gas is directly proportional to its absolute temperature.
 
• 
 
i.e. V ∝ T

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Boyle's law:__**

 __
 
• For a fixed mass of gas at a constant temperature, the volume is inversely proportional to the pressure.
 
• P∝1/V
 
• PV = constant (If the temperature remains constant, the product of pressure and volume of a given mass of a gas is constant.)
 
 
 
• **Avogadro's law:**__
 __
 
• Avogadro’s Law states that at constant temperature and pressure, all equal volumes of gases will have an equal number of molecules" which means 'V' is directly proportional to the 'Number of molecules'.​
 
 
 
• **Joule's law:**__
 
 
• The ratio of the energy consumed in mechanical work (W) and the heat generated (H) by that work remains constant.
 
• J is Joule's constant.** J = 4.186 joule/calorie**

questions.question: Which of the following eye disorders is known as ‘lazy eye’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Amblyopia.**__

__
 
• **Amblyopia: Also known as Lazy eye.**

 
 
• It represents a type of **muscular defect of the eyes** that causes a loss of vision due to muscle imbalance.
 
• It leads to** double vision. **
 
• The brain tries to repress the vision in one eye, resulting in loss of sight to the unused eye.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Presbyopia:**

 
 
• Decreases the power of accommodation and can be corrected by using bi-focal lenses.
 
 
 
• **Hypermetropia:**
 
 
• The focal length of the eye lens is too long and can be corrected by the convex lens of suitable power.
 
 
 
• **Myopia:**
 
 
• Also known as near-sightedness.
 
• The far point is nearer than infinity.
 
• A person with this defect can see nearby objects but cannot see distant objects distinctly.
 
• Image of the distant object is formed in front of the retina.
 
• Arise due to - (a) excessive curvature of the eye lens, (b) elongation of the eyeball.
 
• Correction - concave lens of suitable power.

questions.question: Which river originates from Tibet and enters India through Arunachal Pradesh?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** ​__Brahmaputra River.__**

__
 
• The Brahmaputra River originates from the** Angsi Glacier in Tibet** which is an is an autonomous region of China.
 
• It is knowns as Tsangpo__ in Tibet.
 
• It flows eastwards parallel to the Himalayas. 
 
• On reaching the** Namcha Barwa (7757 m)**, it takes a **‘U’ turn and enters India in Arunachal Pradesh **through a gorge.
 
• Here, it is called the **Dihang** and it is joined by the Dibang, the Lohit, and many other tributaries to form the Brahmaputra in Assam.
 
• The river flows for about 3,848 km (2,391 mi) long which makes it the world's 15th Longe**st river.**
 
• Majuli Island is the first island to be made a district in India between the channels of the Brahmputra river is the largest river island in the world.
 
• The Brahmputra river forms the world's largest and the deepest canyon, Yarlung Tsangpo Grand Canyon while leaving the Tibetan Plateau.
